items.text: Approving various routine parking and traffic modifications (The Planning Department has found that Items A-I are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act [CEQA]. items.title: Approving parking restrictions to create parking space for the exclusive use of San Francisco Fire Department (SFFD) marked vehicles on the north side of Pixley
items.text: Approving parking restrictions to create parking space for the exclusive use of San Francisco Fire Department (SFFD) marked vehicles on the north side of Pixley 5 Street, from 170 feet to 220 feet east of Steiner Street, fronting Fire Station 16, and amending Division II of the Transportation Code to create a parking restriction on Pixley Street. (The SFMTA, under authority delegated by the Planning Department, has determined that the proposed parking and traffic modifications are categorically exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act [CEQA]. Explanatory documents include a staff report and resolution.) RESOLUTION No. 260721-057
